_source: FM 3-11.3, Multiservice Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures for Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear Contamination Avoidance (2006), Appendix G. Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
_how: Read by eye from the nomograms (Figures G-21 and G-22), to about 5%. Figure G-22's scales are logarithmic; their pixel rows (on the 1103 x 1400 image) were fitted as row = a - b log10(value / c), which reproduces the appendix's two worked examples (50 kt at 9 km/h: 22 km; 100 kt at 16 knots: 30 nautical miles) to 2%.

cloud._what: Figure G-21, Radioactive Cloud and Stem Parameters, stabilized at H+10 minutes: [yield kt, cloud top km, cloud bottom km, cloud radius km], above the burst.

zone1._what: Figure G-22, Determination of Zone I, Downwind Distance: a straight line from the effective downwind speed (left) to the yield (right) crosses the distance (middle). Zone I: where someone outdoors may get 125 cGy or more within 4 hours of the fallout arriving. Surface burst, all fission.
